comparison.objective: Insert a retaining fork into a shaft groove; candidate adjusts and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Stabilize a loose fixture while laterally feeding two tines past a shaft centre versus insert a hex bit, loosen, rotate a collar, reacquire and tighten.
comparison.success_condition: Fork seated through the groove, with measured lift credit, versus repeatable safe carriage stops after adjustment.
comparison.reason: Shared alignment and insertion primitives are generic; the retention insertion and damping-commissioning outcomes differ.
